lastCompletedStory.title: Auto-generate the CHANGELOG release-section body from classified branch commits

nextStoryContext: US-006 added generateReleaseBody(subjects) to src/release/changelog.ts: pure function mapping feat/feat! -> ### Added, fix/fix! -> ### Fixed, stripping conventional-commit prefix, omitting empty subsections. rollChangelog gained an optional 4th param releaseBody?: string: when provided, it replaces the hand-maintained [Unreleased] body with the generated body in the versioned section (legacy path preserved for backward compat when param is absent). runShipBump in ship-bump.ts now calls generateReleaseBody(subjects) and passes the result to rollChangelog, fulfilling AC-4. All 1511 tests pass. Next story: check prd.json for the next passes:false entry.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-006 only uses internal project modules (src/release/bump.ts patterns) and built-in regex. No external npm library was touched; no fetch needed.
